title: Choose the visual world for Luma
question: The roll assigned the Scientific Wall Chart. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Scientific Wall Chart
options.lineage: school & laboratory periodic tables, litho-printed wall charts
options.thesis: Every fact you capture becomes a tile on one chart, and the tile's state proves you actually understood it.
options.viewport: The whole first screen is the chart: a ruled grid of knowledge tiles filling the field, a title cartouche top-left holding Learn. Capture. Grow. with a solid ultramarine Get Started block beneath it, and one tile flipping open to reveal Definition / My Understanding / Insight.
options.risk: Reads as a school science poster if the type is timid, and can make personal knowledge feel like a cold taxonomy.

raised.raise: Rationed color (from Rietveld): every colored pixel marks a real state or a real category. No decorative color anywhere on the chart.
Pressable blocks (from the Elbow Panel): every CTA and control is a solid, unambiguous block with a hard active state. No ghost buttons.
Traceability (from the Jacquard loom): every tile traces back to the three-part anatomy that produced its state — the flip reveals Definition, My Understanding, and Insight.

regions.label: How it works: Capture / Organize / Retrieve / Reflect

options.label: The Card Catalog
options.lineage: oak library card catalog, typed index slips
options.thesis: Capture a slip, file it, pull it later — the product loop rendered as furniture.
options.viewport: A drawer bank across the left edge, one card pulled fully into view on the right carrying the headline and a Get Started block stamped like a date slug.
options.risk: Also where most runs in this category land: the most familiar metaphor in note-taking, and nostalgia with no system behind it is the failure mode.

options.label: The Brine Calendar
options.thesis: Knowledge matures in the open, dated and staged like a ferment.
options.viewport: A shelf of staged jars, each a knowledge item whose label band shows its day count and maturity stage.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: maturation stages map exactly onto Captured → Understood → Complete. Holds product clarity, loses audience identification — fermentation is not this audience's world.
options.risk: A food metaphor can trivialize serious study, and the shelf says nothing about retrieval.

options.label: The Normalling Schedule
options.thesis: Status drawn as a link line, never as a color: unbroken, cross-ticked, gapped, ringed.
options.viewport: Numbered amber lanes on black glass, each knowledge row tied to its default by a line whose break shows its state, with one row deliberately left broken.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: line state carries status with zero reliance on hue — the strongest accessibility stance on the table. Holds product clarity, loses audience identification — machine-room patchbays are foreign to a general learner.
options.risk: Machine-room severity can make a personal learning tool feel like equipment rather than a place to think.

options.label: Sliding Planes
options.lineage: 1919–24 De Stijl interiors, Rietveld Schröder house
options.thesis: Sections are repositionable planes; organizing knowledge is literally moving a wall.
options.viewport: White field partitioned by sliding primary planes, the headline set flush to a plane edge.
options.case: Loses both axes: famous inside the design world, not the learner's; reorganization reads clearly but reflection has no place in the grammar.
options.kept: Rationed color — color only ever marks what actually moves.

options.label: Elbow Panel Console
options.thesis: Flat pastel banks on black glass, framed by sweeping elbows.
options.viewport: A black field ruled by thick lilac and peach elbow frames, headline and CTA set flush inside the blocks.
options.case: Loses both axes: nostalgia-niche identification, and a control console carries no learning loop.
options.kept: Every control is an unmistakable pressable block with a hard active state.

options.label: Punched Brocade
options.lineage: jacquard loom punch cards & woven brocade
options.thesis: Thousands of recorded choices resolving into one visible pattern.
options.viewport: Midnight ground with the headline woven in gold small caps over a band of punched instruction rows.
options.case: Loses both axes: loom craft is foreign to this audience, and the traceability it proves is version history — a secondary mechanism, not the core loop.
options.kept: Every visible outcome traces back to the instruction that produced it.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What a productivity landing page ships: light hero, app screenshot in a browser frame, three feature columns, blue pill CTA — executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Headline, subhead, dual CTA, floating app screenshot below the fold line.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
